questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Career opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: That the country is safe, have good morals and can speak english. Also the food is a plus. I also had a friend that took her exchange semester here, and she talked good about her experience.

questions.answer: Easy if you knew where to look, and who to ask.

questions.answer: No assistance.

How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I used Roofinders, and they were really good.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Do not use the facebook groups, it is a lot of scam. Be prepeared that it is expensive to rent here.

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Registration opens 2 weeks before the exam. It was really easy to do it on UNIMIA.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Infopoints at school.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes I wanted to.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Remember to check the time schedule for each class, and make sure that they do not have classes on the same time.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Some courses were difficult, but others were very easy. It depends on the exam method.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Some of the teatchers are not so good in english, and they have different methods to teach. But overall it did work good.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
M&A
Environmental Sustainability
International Refugee Protection and Sustainable Development
Law and Policies of Social Rights Protection in Europe
Collective Redress and Sustainability

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
M&A - very difficult, but very good if you want to work with M&A
Environmental Sustainability - very easy and interesting if you are interested in the environment
International Refugee Protection and Sustainable Development - easy and the teacher was very good
Law and Policies of Social Rights Protection in Europe - easy and interesting topics
Collective Redress and Sustainability - easy, but you have to like redress and the lawsuit process

questions.answer: Como, Venezia, Parma, Bologna, Firenze, Roma.

questions.answer: Easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Go to the events.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Some of the Italians are not good in English

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The food

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Get a travel card on the metro (22 Euro)
Travel in the weekends
Eat a lot of italian food

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer:
All 5 exams are scheduled in two weeks, so be prepared for that. 
There is a lot of strikes, specially on fridays, so often the classes is cancelled or online. 
When you choose classes, pick the ones that are not in the evening.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The culture, food and nice people. Also very good shopping.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The strikes and late classes in the evening.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
